name: ReceiptBatch_ExpenseAttendee
command:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        attendee_name,
        CASE
            WHEN LENGTH(attendee_name) >= 2
                THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(attendee_name, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS search_pattern,
        language_code
    FROM (
        SELECT
            TRIM(${AttendeeName:VARCHAR}) AS attendee_name,
            NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(${P_LANGUAGE:VARCHAR}), ''), 'US') AS language_code
        FROM dual
    )
)
SELECT
    q.person_id AS PERSON_ID,
    q.employee_name AS EMPLOYEE_NAME,
    q.employee_number AS EMPLOYEE_NUMBER,
    q.title AS TITLE,
    q.organization_name AS ORGANIZATION_NAME
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.employee_ID AS person_id,
        p.FULL_NAME AS employee_name,
        p.employee_num AS employee_number,
        pos.NAME AS title,
        org.NAME AS organization_name
    FROM APPS.PER_EMPLOYEES_X p,
         APPS.PER_ASSIGNMENTS_X a,
         (
             SELECT
                 PAP.POSITION_ID,
                 PFT.NAME
             FROM APPS.PER_ALL_POSITIONS PAP,
                  APPS.HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F_TL PFT,
                  params
             WHERE DECODE(APPS.HR_SECURITY.VIEW_ALL, 'Y', 'TRUE', APPS.HR_SECURITY.SHOW_RECORD('PER_ALL_POSITIONS', PAP.POSITION_ID)) = 'TRUE'
               AND DECODE(APPS.hr_general.get_xbg_profile, 'Y', pap.business_group_id, APPS.hr_general.get_business_group_id) = pap.business_group_id
               AND PAP.POSITION_ID = PFT.POSITION_ID
               AND PFT.LANGUAGE = params.language_code
         ) pos,
         (
             SELECT
                 HAO.ORGANIZATION_ID,
                 HAOTL.NAME
             FROM APPS.HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS HAO,
                  APPS.HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_TL HAOTL,
                  params
             WHERE DECODE(APPS.HR_SECURITY.VIEW_ALL, 'Y', 'TRUE', APPS.HR_SECURITY.SHOW_RECORD('HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS', HAOTL.ORGANIZATION_ID)) = 'TRUE'
               AND DECODE(APPS.hr_general3.get_xbg_profile, 'Y', hao.business_group_id, APPS.hr_general3.get_business_group_id) = hao.business_group_id
               AND HAO.ORGANIZATION_ID = HAOTL.ORGANIZATION_ID
               AND HAOTL.LANGUAGE = params.language_code
         ) org,
         params
    WHERE a.assignment_id = p.assignment_id
      AND a.position_id = pos.position_id(+)
      AND a.organization_id = org.organization_id
      AND params.search_pattern IS NOT NULL
      AND UPPER(p.FULL_NAME) LIKE UPPER(params.search_pattern) ESCAPE '\'
    ORDER BY p.FULL_NAME ASC,
             p.employee_ID ASC
) q
WHERE ROWNUM <= 51
